about: Requests for measuring whether a model picks the right tool as its first step (tools/tool_choice_benchmark.py). 'dev' is the set the prompt in agent/toolcall.py was written against. 'heldout' was written at the same time and run once afterwards, with nothing adjusted to it: its score is the one to quote. 'expect' is the tool the first step should name, or 'answer' when no tool is needed; 'arguments' says what the call must contain (an exact address, or at least one of the listed words in the query). 'loops' are whole runs with the tools' results fixed in advance.
